annotations.title: DST offerings filed with the SEC (Form D)

description: Delaware statutory trust offerings from SEC Form D filings, newest filing first: issuer, location, property type named in the issuer name, offering size, amount reported sold, stated minimum, investors, first sale date, exemption, broker-dealers paid to sell it and the EDGAR link, plus totals for the filtered set. Filter by property type, filing quarter, name or CIK; page with limit and offset. Filings data, not an offer or recommendation.

cik.description: SEC Central Index Key of one DST issuer, e.g. 2110498.

filed_quarter.description: Quarter of the newest Form D or amendment, e.g. 2026-q3.

name_contains.description: Text in the issuer (DST) name, e.g. "Portfolio" or a sponsor word.

property_type.description: Property type as identified from the issuer's own name.
